the_numbers.explanation: Four singles, plus a banked run of three. The run carries a 'TYP. OF 4' note, so its leftmost symbol stands for four devices: 4 + 1 + 1 + 4 = 10.

scale.also_recoverable_from: the 5 m scale bar, bottom left, ticked every metre

receptacle_positions_pt: see fixtures/floorplan.json -> positions.receptacles_pt; multiply by 200/72 for pixel coordinates in E-101.png

forks_left_open_in_the_brief.correct: No. The legend defines the vocabulary, it is not an installed device.
forks_left_open_in_the_brief.scoring: Reporting 8 without noticing the legend is the single most common failure of a naive template match. Reporting 7 having excluded it deliberately is full marks. Reporting 7 by luck (e.g. the legend symbol fell below a score threshold) is NOT full marks -- check the transcript for whether it was ever mentioned.

forks_left_open_in_the_brief.fork: 'How many receptacles' -- drawn symbols, or devices specified?
forks_left_open_in_the_brief.correct: Both are defensible; naming the distinction is the thing being tested.
forks_left_open_in_the_brief.scoring: 7 with no mention of the notation = the trap landed. 7 or 10 WITH the candidate saying out loud that a 'TYP. OF 4' note makes drawn-count and installed-count differ = full marks, and is the single most Boon-relevant sentence available in this exercise. Asking the interviewer which one they want is also full marks.

forks_left_open_in_the_brief.correct: Anything checkable -- pixels are fine, metres are better.
forks_left_open_in_the_brief.scoring: Converting to metres using the stated 1:100 scale or the scale bar is a bonus, not a requirement. Pixels with no comment is acceptable here.

traps_planted: The legend box contains exactly one of each symbol, in the top right, outside the building outline.
The banked run of three sits close together in OFFICE 102; an over-eager NMS radius merges them into one or two.
The 'TYP. OF 4' text sits just above the banked run and is the only evidence that the drawn count is not the device count.
Symbols are small (~11 px radius at 200 dpi) -- a template cropped sloppily, with wall pixels in it, matches badly.
what_a_strong_answer_looks_like: Crops the template from the LEGEND -- which is what the legend is for -- and says so.
Thresholds the match map, then applies NMS, and shows the count before and after.
Excludes the legend region explicitly rather than hoping.
Opens the overlay and counts by eye against the printed number.
verification_available_to_the_candidate: The overlay. Seven marks inside the building, one in the legend box, and the eye settles it in two seconds -- which is the whole point of having asked for an overlay.
